inventory.name: Longbow
inventory.description: Ranged, range 150/600 ft, 1d8 piercing damage, two-handed, needs both hands to shoot

inventory.name: Longsword
inventory.description: Melee, 1d8 slashing damage, versatile 1d10 when held in two hands
inventory.text: The blade belonged to the guard of the eastern gate — his name is engraved on it.

inventory.name: Chain Shirt
inventory.description: Medium armor, AC 14 + Dex (max 2), disadvantage on Stealth, takes 10 minutes to don

inventory.name: Arrows
inventory.description: Ammunition for a bow; after a fight half of them break and cannot be recovered

inventory.name: Quiver
inventory.description: Holds up to 20 arrows, attaches to the belt, quick access as a bonus action

inventory.name: Explorer's Pack
inventory.description: Backpack, bedroll, tinderbox, torches (10), rations (10), 50 ft of rope, mess kit

inventory.name: Dagger
inventory.description: Melee/thrown, range 20/60 ft, 1d4 piercing damage, light weapon

inventory.name: Gold Coins
inventory.description: Standard currency. 1 gp = 10 sp = 100 cp. Weight is ignored up to 500 coins.

inventory.name: Heart of Balor
inventory.description: A ruby of the cult of the Bloody Hand. Warm to the touch, a dark light pulses inside it.

inventory.name: Shield
inventory.description: A light wooden shield, +2 to Armor Class, takes one hand

inventory.name: Potion of Healing
inventory.description: Restores 2d4+2 hit points when drunk, takes an action to use

inventory.name: Silk Rope
inventory.description: 50 feet, holds 250 pounds, does not rot from damp

inventory.name: Torch
inventory.description: Burns for 1 hour, sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius

inventory.name: Thieves' Tools
inventory.description: A tool for picking locks, requires proficiency to be effective

inventory.name: Wanderer's Cloak
inventory.description: Gives advantage on Stealth checks in the wilderness

inventory.name: Ring of Protection
inventory.description: +1 to Armor Class and saving throws, requires 1 hour of attunement

inventory.name: Dungeon Map
inventory.description: An incomplete map of the upper levels, with known traps marked

inventory.name: Elven Flute
inventory.description: A musical instrument, gives a bonus to Performance checks

inventory.name: Bag of Sand
inventory.description: Used to create a distraction or put out fire

abilities.name: Fighting Style: Archery
abilities.description: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons, does not apply in melee

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10+1 hit points, once per rest

abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
abilities.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, magic can't put you to sleep

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.description: Proficiency in the Perception skill, adds the proficiency bonus

abilities.name: Trance
abilities.description: Meditating for 4 hours replaces 8 hours of sleep; you stay partly aware

abilities.name: Elf Weapon Training
abilities.description: Proficiency with longbow and shortbow, longsword and shortsword

abilities.name: Stealthy Hunter
abilities.description: Advantage on Stealth if you move no more than half your speed

abilities.name: Natural Instinct
abilities.description: You leave no tracks in the wilderness when walking normally

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can make an extra bow shot once per turn

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Ignores three-quarters cover when shooting at a visible target

abilities.name: Herb Expert
abilities.description: Advantage on Nature checks involving plants and poisons

abilities.name: Voice of the Forest
abilities.description: Understands simple animal signals, not full speech

abilities.name: Battle Composure
abilities.description: You don't get disadvantage from fear at the sight of a superior foe

abilities.name: Uncanny Dodge
abilities.description: As a reaction, you can halve the damage from one attack per round

abilities.name: Danger Sense
abilities.description: Advantage on saving throws against traps and area effects you can see

abilities.name: Ranger's Sixth Sense
abilities.description: You don't lose a target's trail even if you lose sight of it for a short time

abilities.name: Poison Resilience
abilities.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, resistance to poison damage

abilities.name: Elven Night Vision
abilities.description: You see in dim light as if it were daylight and can tell colors in the dark

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
abilities.description: Speed increased by 10 feet in light armor or no armor

abilities.name: True Shot
abilities.description: Reroll one d20 when you miss with a ranged attack, once per rest

abilities.name: Field Medic
abilities.description: Gives the target an extra Hit Die on a short rest, as an action

abilities.name: Calm Spirit
abilities.description: Advantage on saving throws against fear and domination

abilities.name: Tracking Expert
abilities.description: Automatic success when tracking creatures of a known type

narrative.world: A grim dark fantasy world on the border of the kingdom of Azarin. An abandoned dungeon beneath the ruins of an old monastery has been seized by the cult of the Bloody Hand.
narrative.currentArc: Heart of Balor — the cult's ruby

plotThreads.name: The Cult's Ritual
plotThreads.description: Morag the Cultist is performing a ritual in the Sacrificial Hall.

plotThreads.name: Kerim the Prisoner
plotThreads.description: An emaciated man is chained up in the cell.

npcs.name: Kerim
npcs.notes: A prisoner in the cell, knows the cult's secrets

npcs.name: Morag
npcs.notes: A cultist spellcaster, leader of the lair.

history.author: DM
history.text: You stand in a quiet stone room; torches crackle faintly on the walls.
